meta.name: Tiktiki
meta.description:
When a man accepts the invitation to spend an evening with his lover's husband, what starts as a series of mind games quickly turns into a deadly game of revenge, murder and more.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: The Guest
videos.overview: A lonely and arrogant Soumendra Krishna Deb invites Milan Basak to his palace. When Milan arrives, Soumendra keeps demeaning him and ultimately makes him a bizarre offer.

videos.title: The Plot
videos.overview: Soumendra makes Milan another tempting offer that he can't refuse. Milan is forced to act against his wish, thereby hurting his self-respect.

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: Soumendra guides Milan in staging a 'perfect' crime. But nothing is like how it seems.

videos.title: The Cop
videos.overview: The arrival of an unexpected guest dampens Soumendra's celebratory mood. Not only that, the guest also manipulates Soumendra into divulging something incriminating.

videos.title: The Interrogation
videos.overview: The pride of Soumendra Krishna Deb is shattered step by step as evidence against him mounts up.

videos.title: The Final Showdown
videos.overview: The two warriors are now even. But does the game end here?
